text:
ajay: quick follow-up from the prefetched-lease spike — saw a nondeterministic read-after-write in staging when a prefix got demoted during a lease reshuffle. repro steps below.

ajay: minimal repro: two concurrent requests, one writes a key under prefix P, another demotes P mid-flight. sometimes the reader sees stale value 

ajay: logs snippet:```
[1764448801.123] write id=42 prefix=P k=0x7f val=v2
[1764448801.124] demote prefix=P lease=epoch-17
[1764448801.125] read id=43 prefix=P k=0x7f -> v1
```

devon: ack. this feels like a visibility window where demote tears down residency before write fully applied to shared slab. could be ordering between apply & demote notification.

maria.dev: +1. did you hit any tombstone/compact interactions? if demote triggers compaction we might be collapsing in-memory view.

ajay: i instrumented: no tombstone compaction in that window. looks like demote triggers eviction path that invalidates KV entry but write was still in-flight to the local apply queue.

lee: potential fixes: (1) linearize demote behind an epoch fence so any in-flight writes with lower epoch are applied or aborted, (2) make demote wait for local apply-queue drain for prefixes flagged as hot, (3) make read path check pending-writes for matches before returning stale. tradeoffs: (1) adds latency to demote, (2) waiting can stall eviction throughput during big reshuffles, (3) read-path check costs extra lookup.

devon: prefer (3) as short term safety — cheap per-key check keyed by request's sequence number, only on demote-in-progress prefixes. low perf hit if we gate behind a bitmap of prefixes currently demoting.

ajay: agree for short-term. need metrics & guardrails. suggestions for telemetry: demote.start/demote.end, pending-write-count-at-demote, stale-read-detected, read-checked-pending-writes.

maria.dev: add a debug flag to force demote to wait for queue drain for canary to validate fix without global rollback. ops-bot can coordinate canaries.

ops-bot: noted: scheduling canary for eng-runtime/staging cluster tonight 02:00 UTC. will post results. :calendar: :hammer_and_wrench:

ajay: test plan: 1) synthetic churn harness that triggers reshuffles while doing RW pairs at high QPS, 2) assert linearizability under 10k ops window, 3) collect the telemetry counters you mentioned, 4) enable debug wait flag in canary.

lee: impl sketch for read-check (short):```go
func Read(prefix, key) {
  v := readFromCache(prefix, key)
  if demoteInProgress(prefix) {
    if pending := checkPendingWrites(prefix, key); pending != nil {
      return pending.value
    }
  }
  return v
}
```

devon: edge: if pending write later fails/aborts we must not return it to reader. so check pending's commit-state. we have commit markers on apply-queue entries. good to re-use.

ajay: ops question: telemetry thresholds to alert? propose stale-read-detected rate > 1e-4 of reads over 5m -> paging channel and automatically increase demote-wait param for that cluster.

maria.dev: +1. also add histogram of pending-write-duration at demote start. helps tune wait time.

deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: eng-runtime/prefetch-fix-canary v0.9.3 -> staging @ 1764449400.

ajay: updating the RFC follow-up doc with the short-term mitigation (read-check) + metrics + canary plan. will post link when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
